scene.tutorial.step.intro.title: Welcome
scene.tutorial.step.intro.description: Your goal is simple: smash as many bricks as possible before your sanity runs out. Sanity is your mental stamina—it drains over time, so start breaking immediately.
scene.tutorial.step.summonBlueVanguard.d: Spawn as many creatures as you can by spamming Blue Vanguard. When you run out of mana or your sanity drops after cracking a few bricks, we'll pause and continue.
scene.tutorial.step.summonBlueVanguard.l: Spend your mana on summons and break a few bricks to continue
scene.tutorial.step.mana.title: Mana for Rituals
scene.tutorial.step.mana.description: Mana fuels both summons and spells. It regenerates on its own—spend it freely to break more bricks before sanity fades.
scene.tutorial.step.castMagicArrow.title: Spellcasting
scene.tutorial.step.castMagicArrow.descr: Spells are another way to destroy bricks. You can select one of the available spells from the list. Then clicking on the map will cast the spell at that location.
scene.tutorial.step.castMagicArrow.lockM: Select Magic Arrow and click on the map to cast it
scene.tutorial.step.progress.title: Don't Fear Failure
scene.tutorial.step.progress.description: If you can't shatter every brick, that's fine. Every brick you destroy drops resources—use them to return stronger next time.
